hypothesis: Absolute momentum depends on market heat; top relative leaders and emerging leaders need explicit ordinal context. Existing sector return spreads do not encode ranks within the fixed observed universe.
features: Within-session mid-ranks of prior 20-day/5-day returns and completed opening return/relative volume, plus persistence=min(prior20 rank, opening rank), emergence=opening rank-prior20 rank
cohort: Every observed full-universe candidate at that completed opening cutoff, including opening-not-ready and native-guard-rejected observations; never future outcomes
fixed: Current 89 features, inherited spline basis, alpha=120, expanding mature history, 20-session refits, quantity ladder, execution, costs and risk gates
scope: Adaptive development hypothesis; same reused history, no June-July access; report all trials
